Output 1.1 One regional training workshop at the Wildlife Friends Foundation Thailand 2122 September 2022a regional training workshop was conducted by UNODC at the Wildlife Friends Foundation of Thailand in Phetchaburi province. The workshop gathered 15 counterparts from Thailand Viet Nam and Lao PDR government agencies 7 participants from Thailand DNP DLD and DDC 2 males 5 females 6 participants from Lao PDR DoFI DLF DOF 4 males 2 females and 2 participants from Viet Nam MARD 2 males. The twoday training event helped the participants gain a better understanding of the logistic challenges for actual field visits improved their understanding of the twopart assessment process of questionnaire and observational recording and increased their familiarity with the equipment tablet computer and cameras used during the assessments.Output 1.1 First Scientific Advisory Committee meeting 26 January 2022 the technical meeting was aimed to introduce the SAFE project and inform the participants on the ToR and purpose of the SAC supporting the SAFE project in the elaboration of a risk assessment framework. Discussions covered a tool for rapid assessment of wildlife markets in the AsiaPacific Region for risk of future zoonotic disease outbreaks as well as survey teams and Protective Personal Equipment requirements. The meeting was attended by 12 scientists and specialists 6 male 4 female in addition to 2 males from the UNODC Secretariat.Output 1.1 Second Scientific Advisory Committee meeting 3 March 2022 the technical meeting was held to update the participants on the risk assessment framework and to discuss the recent IUCN SSC publication Situation analysis on the roles and risks of wildlife in the emergence of human infectious diseases. The meeting was attended by 5 scientists and specialists male in addition to 2 male and 2 female from the UNODC Secretariat.Output 1.1 Third Scientific Advisory Committee meeting 4 May 2022 the technical meeting was held to discuss the content of the questionnaire and some results from the illegality profiling exercise. The meeting was attended by 4 scientists and specialists 3 male one female in addition to 2 male and 1 female from the UNODC Secretariat.Output 1.1 Fourth Scientific Advisory Committee meeting 29 August 2022 The meeting was aimed at discussing project implementation and challenges presenting the questionnaire explaining the finalised risk assessment framework and give an overview of the field survey plan in the four priority countries. 9 participants 6 males 3 females. 5 from international organizations 1 from government 2 from academia.Output 1.1 Fifth Scientific Advisory Committee meeting 16 February 2023 the meeting was attended by 4 members 1 female 3 males. The meeting provided some updates on the project implementation and sharing challenges in starting field activities.
